notes.title: Version 0.0.7 released!
notes.notes:
In this update we added a new map, a new obstacle and minor fixes.

Map

 Added a new map
 Added new sprites
 Added an obstacle called Crube


Misc

 Added up arrow key as jump button
 Bugfix: prevent players from jumping whilst the in game menu has focus

notes.title: Version 0.0.6 released!
notes.notes:
In this update we added a new map, new sprites, new effects and more obstacles. Also several bugfixes have been applied.

Map

 Added 1 new map
 Added trampoline obstacle
 Added more fruity collectables
 Added movement effect
 Added fruit collected effect
 Added background sprite
 Added forest floor sprite
 Added candy floor sprite


Bugfixes

 Fixed player acceleration physics to prevent moonwalking
 Fixed player deceleration physics to prevent sliding


Misc

 Increased round duration from 7 to 14 days
 Improved state machine player can now have multiple states simultaneously
 Cleared leaderboard

notes.title: Version 0.0.5 released!
notes.notes:
In this update we added new maps and a tournament system. Every week a new round will start offering new chances for players to get into the top!

Map

 Added 2 new maps


Misc

 Added tournament system
 Cleared leaderboard

notes.title: Version 0.0.4 released!
notes.notes:
In this update we added a new map and improved the knockback mechanic. The leaderboards are cleared so there is a new chance to get into the top!

Player

 Increased knockback mechanic
 Added a time penalty of 1 second when hit, movement on floor will be disabled during this period


Map

 Added new map
 Added checkpoint system


Misc

 Cleared leaderboard

notes.title: Version 0.0.3 released!
notes.notes:
In this update we improved the movement and jumping mechanics making the game a little bit easier. We also fixed minor bugs and improved the display of error messages.

Player

 Increased movement speed
 Improved jump mechanic enabling controlling the player in mid air whilst jumping from an idle position


Map

 Added a restart shortcut (“R” key) to quickly reload the map
 Added coyote time


Bugs

 Disabled WASD input in main menu
 Improved error message to be human readable in character registration step
